sources.excerpt: - **Builder:** Cajita Stompboxes - **Catalog type:** Overdrive - **Identity:** Bass preamp/overdrive unit combining a BDI-style preamp with a separate TS-style distortion/overdrive section. Cajita describes the unit as a bass preamp with a separate distortion section. The distortion section is described as a **Tube Screamer-type circuit modified for bass**, usable independently as a booster, overdrive, or heavier distortion. The documented distortion controls are: - Gain - Tone - Vol The BDI preamp section has: - Hi - Low - Presencia - Mid - Drive - Blend - Vol - Mono input - Mono output plus XLR output - 9V battery or transformer - 48V phantom power through XLR - Metal enclosure 1. Cajita Stompboxes product page: https://pedalescajita.mitiendanube.com/productos/bdi-ts-preamplificador-bajo-con-overdrive/ 2. The distortion can operate as booster, overdrive or heavier distortion, with **Gain, Tone, Vol** controls. The BDI preamp adds Hi, Low, Presencia, Mid, Drive, Blend and Vol. It has mono input, mono and XLR outputs, 9V battery/transformer power and 48V phantom power via XLR.
